questions.answer: Personal connection to the destination (heritage / friends there/ etc.)

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: That it was a bigger city so that I could take dance classes. That I could understand the language. And the rich nature very close!!!

How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer:
It was relatively easy! I looked a lot on "
finn.no
" and got some differennt opportunities there, but ended up applying for a room at a student home.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: I lived in a student home called "Blindern Studenterhjem". Very recommendable! I live with 200 Norwegian students and 3 other Danes. Very social place with a lot of social events. Hung out mostly with people from there. They like to have exchange students from Denmark.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: The housing available to students through sio did not look very appealing to me, but I was very contennt with where I ended up!

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: I don't remember the details, but I recall a lot of bureaucracy. A lot of back and forth (same as with KU). Made it harder than it had to be.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: I went to the university information office of my faculty a lot. They helped me.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I got the classes I applied for.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Be aware of when and how the exams are. Make it easy for yourself. Make room and time for yourself to have fun and enjoy the last period of your stay as well as the first part. So you don't rush and have no time to see the people you're going to say goodbye to in the end because of exams.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: It varied. Had one introduction course, that was pretty easy. The two other courses were very intersting to me. Learned a lot. The level might be a bit below KU.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Pretty similar.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.answer:
Introduction to developmental psychology
Social ulikhet i helse - et biopsykososialt perspektiv

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: The 2nd course I listed (Social ulikhet i helse - et biopsykososialt perspektiv) was really innteresting. Had Pål Kraft as lecturer. Very nspiring. Was in Norwegian, but was easy to understand.

questions.answer: Go hiking! Se Preikestolen or Kjerak bolten. Lofoten Islands.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: very easy. Everyone were very welcoming. And similar to danish culture.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Be brave. Do thigns on your own. Go to events. You will meet people. Be open to experiences... If that's what you want...

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: none

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: outdoor lifestyle
